sheet.summary: Popular maritime legend claims that a 52-tonne magnetic lodestone sat atop the Konark Sun Temple, causing the central idol to levitate and pulling European ships onto nearby reefs until foreign sailors removed it. Archaeological investigations show no physical evidence of a giant crowning magnet, though builders did use heavy wrought-iron beams in the structure and engineered the 24 base wheels as functional sundials. Historians and engineers disagree on the cause of the main sanctuary tower's collapse, debating whether poor soil bearing capacity, structural overloading, saline weathering of iron ties, or military desecration caused the ruin. It remains unknown whether the colossal vimana was ever fully consecrated to its intended height before catastrophic subsidence occurred.
